Under the general direction of the UC Irvine Assistant Director, the LIFTED Statewide Support Service Coordinator uses skills as a seasoned, experienced public education student services program professional to streamline online and in person workshop delivery to ensure incarcerated student access to a wide range of UC student support services, across departments and campuses, including library resources, tutoring, disability services, career services, etc. Responsible for resolving a wide range of student service program issues and needs assessments, maximizing online and in-person accessibility of programming from within and across campuses. Develops new student service programs and works on complex student service programs of diverse scope. Demonstrates good judgment in selecting methods and techniques for delivering student services, presentations and development programs.

The LIFTED Statewide Support Service Coordinator will also collaborate with campus departments, community-based organizations, and the California Department of Corrections and Rehabilitation to develop partnerships and referral pathways that support the successful reentry of currently enrolled LIFTED students and LIFTED alumni returning home from prison. This work includes identifying and sharing resources related to career development, employment, housing, business and entrepreneurship opportunities, education, and other evidence-based reentry needs. This position establishes and maintains a coordinated system of information, referrals, and cross-sector partnerships that enables LIFTED programs to help mitigate common barriers following release and connect students with timely resources as they transition home, return to campus, and/or continue their studies.

Receives general instructions and exercises judgment in selecting methods and techniques for course and instructional improvement. Fully knowledgeable in student services programs, campus and UC policy and procedure, as well as the California Department of Corrections and Rehabilitation rules and regulations. Travel semi-regularly to California Department of Corrections and Rehabilitation facilities located in Southern California to work with LIFTED students and deploy workshops and resources.

Important Info: 2-Year Contract position with full benefits. Must be willing to travel to and from 3 UC Campuses and California prison facilities 25% of the time. Fully remote position with the potential of office space at UC Irvine in the future. Must be able to submit and pass a background check to enter CA Department of Corrections and Rehabilitation Facilities. Experience with the criminal legal system.
Must be able to travel to and from California prisons and UC campuses.

Ability to effectively manage multiple priorities and deadlines. Excellent multitasking and follow-through skills; able to work under pressure managing multiple projects with attention to details.
